replay.recorded_configuration_unavailabl: Recorded configuration unavailable; complete values were not logged: {values}
replay.warning.firmware_build_differs_fr: The log firmware build differs from the current offline reimplementation; replay is treated as approximate.
replay.warning.source_log_has_integrity_: The source log has integrity errors or record-sequence gaps; replay is treated as approximate.
replay.warning.input_sample_gaps_detecte: Input sample gaps were segmented without interpolation; replay is treated as approximate.
replay.warning.system_config_missing_cur: SYSTEM_CONFIG is missing, so replay uses the current firmware sampling bounds and is treated as approximate.
replay.warning.measurement_application_t: The measurement application time was not fully recorded and was inferred from the inertial timeline.
replay.warning.kf6_state_timing_referenc: The KF6 state timing reference is decimated, so measurement application timing can only be reproduced approximately.
replay.warning.fccg_0_0_10_host_golden_n: FCCG 0.0.10 has not yet passed real-log host golden-result validation, so replay remains approximate.
replay.warning.host_golden_not_verified: No matching real-log host golden-result reference is registered, so replay remains approximate.
parameter.tooltip.gravity_mps2: Navigation gravity subtraction only; calibration, alignment and sensor conversion retain their separate platform gravity.
parameter.tooltip.process_accel_std: This parameter constructs prediction-stage process noise Q and represents unmodelled acceleration error in inertial prediction. It is neither live GNSS accuracy nor simply static IMU white noise.
parameter.tooltip.nis_threshold: NIS consistency-gating threshold; the soft threshold applies weighting and the hard threshold rejects the measurement.
parameter.tooltip.nis_max_r_scale: Actual dimensionless cap already used by soft gating; not a multiplier of a hidden default.

parameter.tooltip.gnss_position_std_vert: Actual sigma floor, not fixed R. Existing sigma=max(receiver sigma * 1.25, floor); R=sigma squared. Horizontal E/N share one floor; velocity E/N/U share one floor.
